responsibility: This file implements C expression construction and semantic type checking. It builds typed tree expressions for operators, assignments, calls, initializers, `va_arg`, and other C constructs; performs C-specific implicit conversion, lvalue, constant-expression, compatibility, and initializer diagnostics; manages state for contexts such as `sizeof`, `alignof`, `typeof`, and OpenMP loop parsing; and provides core comparison utilities like C tree equality and type compatibility that the rest of the C front end relies on before lowering.
